description: Checks for management controls, logistics, safety, and readiness in public events.

requirements.title: Venue and capacity confirmation
requirements.description: The venue, capacity, access, and layout match the expected audience.
requirements.why_it_matters: Venue constraints affect every other logistical decision.
requirements.consequence: Attendees may be unable to enter or the event may be unsafe.
requirements.action: Confirm booking, capacity, accessibility, layout, setup time, and venue rules.
requirements.impact_rationale: venue failure can prevent the event from operating

requirements.title: University approval and compliance
requirements.description: The host institution has approved the event and any required conditions are documented.
requirements.why_it_matters: Institutional approval establishes permission, accountability, and applicable rules.
requirements.consequence: The event could be delayed, restricted, or cancelled.
requirements.action: Keep the approval record, conditions, and university contact available to the organizing team.
requirements.impact_rationale: missing approval can stop a university event

requirements.title: Event program confirmation
requirements.description: The planned technical events, owners, timings, and requirements are confirmed.
requirements.why_it_matters: A confirmed program gives teams a shared operating plan.
requirements.consequence: Activities may conflict, start late, or lack required resources.
requirements.action: Publish a program sheet with event owners, timings, room needs, and equipment requirements.
requirements.impact_rationale: an unconfirmed program creates coordination risk

requirements.title: Budget allocation and expense tracking
requirements.description: The budget has a detailed category-level allocation, owner, approval trail, and spend tracker.
requirements.why_it_matters: A total budget and sponsorship amount do not show whether essential costs are controlled.
requirements.consequence: The event can exceed its budget or leave critical purchases unfunded.
requirements.action: Create an itemized expense sheet with planned versus actual spend, category owners, invoices, and daily review points.
requirements.impact_rationale: financial controls protect the event budget and essential purchases
negative_evidence: have not prepared a detailed expense breakdown

requirements.title: Contingency reserve and financial buffer
requirements.description: A defined portion of the budget is reserved for justified unforeseen costs.
requirements.why_it_matters: Unexpected repairs, supplier changes, and safety needs can require rapid spending.
requirements.consequence: Organizers may have no funding for a necessary response.
requirements.action: Set a contingency reserve, define its amount, and record the approval path for releasing it.
requirements.impact_rationale: unplanned costs can disrupt event delivery

requirements.title: Registration and coordination staffing
requirements.description: Named volunteers own registration, participant support, and coordination shifts.
requirements.why_it_matters: Clear delegation prevents queues and unowned tasks at busy times.
requirements.consequence: Participants may wait, receive inconsistent information, or miss activities.
requirements.action: Publish a shift roster with contact numbers, check-in roles, and escalation ownership.
evidence: volunteers assigned to registration and coordination

requirements.title: Technical support staffing and equipment readiness
requirements.description: A dedicated technical support team owns equipment setup, connectivity, troubleshooting, and rapid replacement.
requirements.why_it_matters: Registration volunteers cannot reliably resolve technical failures during multiple technical events.
requirements.consequence: Technical events may be delayed or unable to run.
requirements.action: Assign technical leads by venue, inventory essential equipment, test it before opening, and keep replacement contacts available.
requirements.impact_rationale: technical failure can halt multiple programmed events
negative_evidence: dedicated technical support team is missing
have not assigned a technical support team
technical support team is not prepared

requirements.title: Food and resource planning
requirements.description: Food, materials, and quantities reflect the expected attendance.
requirements.why_it_matters: Resources must be ordered before the event and may have lead times.
requirements.consequence: Attendees may lack essential materials or refreshments.
requirements.action: Confirm quantities, dietary needs, delivery timing, and an inventory owner.

requirements.title: Promotion and participant communications
requirements.description: Participants receive clear event information, updates, and registration instructions.
requirements.why_it_matters: Promotion needs to convert into accurate attendance and informed participation.
requirements.consequence: Attendance, arrivals, or participant expectations may be affected.
requirements.action: Publish the event schedule, registration information, contact channel, and update plan alongside promotional material.
requirements.impact_rationale: clear communication supports attendance and coordination

requirements.title: Schedule buffers and event-delay contingency
requirements.description: The program has time buffers, a delayed-event decision owner, and a communicated fallback sequence.
requirements.why_it_matters: A two-day technical fest can be disrupted by late setup, technical faults, or extended sessions.
requirements.consequence: Delays can cascade across venues and reduce the number of events delivered.
requirements.action: Add buffers between events, name a schedule controller, and prepare an abbreviated or reordered agenda for delayed activities.
requirements.impact_rationale: a delay can cascade through the two-day program
negative_evidence: backup schedule for delayed events is missing
no backup schedule for delayed events
have not prepared a backup schedule

requirements.title: Emergency spending authority and approval limits
requirements.description: Named organizers can approve urgent expenditure within documented limits.
requirements.why_it_matters: Emergency decisions often cannot wait for a normal approval cycle.
requirements.consequence: A necessary repair, safety response, or supplier replacement may be delayed.
requirements.action: Set spending limits, named approvers, a reachable escalation contact, and a record of emergency purchases.
requirements.impact_rationale: delayed financial decisions can prevent a timely operational response
negative_evidence: have not prepared emergency spending authorization

requirements.title: Sponsor deliverables and acknowledgement
requirements.description: Sponsor benefits, branding, invoices, and event-day commitments are documented.
requirements.why_it_matters: Secured funding still needs clear obligations and communication.
requirements.consequence: Sponsor expectations may be missed or funding follow-up may become difficult.
requirements.action: Confirm deliverables, brand-placement approvals, payment status, contact ownership, and post-event reporting.
requirements.impact_rationale: unmanaged sponsor obligations can affect funding relationships

requirements.title: Vendor and supplier confirmation
requirements.description: External suppliers have confirmed timing, contact details, and fallback arrangements.
requirements.why_it_matters: Food, equipment, and printing can depend on third parties.
requirements.consequence: Late or missing deliveries can disrupt the event.
requirements.action: Confirm vendor contacts, delivery windows, payment status, and replacement options.
requirements.impact_rationale: supplier failures can affect event operations

requirements.title: Emergency and safety arrangements
requirements.description: Safety, first aid, exits, and escalation contacts are known.
requirements.why_it_matters: Organizers must be ready for foreseeable incidents.
requirements.consequence: A safety incident may be handled slowly or incorrectly.
requirements.action: Review emergency exits, first aid availability, venue contacts, and incident procedure.
requirements.impact_rationale: safety incidents need a timely, coordinated response

requirements.title: Final readiness review
requirements.description: The organizing team has a final cross-functional review before the event begins.
requirements.why_it_matters: A single review catches gaps between budget, schedule, teams, and suppliers.
requirements.consequence: Small uncoordinated issues may become event-day failures.
requirements.action: Run a readiness review seven days and one day before the event using owners, due dates, and escalation decisions.
requirements.impact_rationale: a final review helps catch unresolved dependencies
negative_evidence: have not completed a readiness review
